trigger_condition.shape_trigger: bias tensor shape is not broadcastable to the matrix multiplication output shape
trigger_condition.value_trigger: beta=0.0 causes the bias contribution to be ignored in eager mode
trigger_condition.state_trigger: torch.compile enabled with Inductor backend and fullgraph=True
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: compiled graph shape validation occurs during compilation
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: torch.addmm bias shape not broadcastable to output while beta=0.0; backend='inductor'; fullgraph=True

root_cause.backend_layer: Inductor compiler performs shape validation that does not preserve eager beta=0 semantics for non-broadcastable bias

bug_oracle.description: torch.compile fails with BackendCompilerFailed and reports a broadcasting failure because the bias shape does not match the output matrix shape.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary beta and alpha values, especially beta=0 and alpha=0, to change whether operands are effectively used.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct bias tensors with shapes that are not broadcastable to the matmul output; vary matrix dimensions and broadcasting relationships.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Run the same operation under eager execution and torch.compile with Inductor backend and fullgraph=True.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch.addmm with incompatible bias shapes and transposed weights; extend to other functions with coefficient-disabled optional operands.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare eager and compiled execution; flag cases where eager succeeds but compiled execution raises a compiler exception, especially when an operand is semantically disabled.
